During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] used an '''''Eta''-class shuttle''' to deliver his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], to [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], where she was to teach classes at the [[Royal Academy of Government/Legends|Royal Academy of Government]].
